data: Synthetic PR fixtures. QA uses real local Auth, API, and database; prototype interactions are simulated.

captures.caption: Prototype: a personal workspace invitation introduces the selected repositories and optional labeling.
Prototype: Human reviews surfaces teammate comments and the reviewer’s own comments on eligible PRs.
Prototype on mobile: the source hunk, verbatim human comment, and Good/Bad/Skip actions remain readable.
QA: the invited account can join the workspace from a personal URL ending in /invite; joining alone does not grant training consent.
QA: a teammate’s verbatim comment is anchored to its source hunk, with Good/Bad/Skip and a clear consent notice.
QA: a Greptile comment is shown with the original hunk, a disagreeing reply, resolution, and later approval so the reviewer can judge the flag.
QA: an optional one-line missed issue is attached to a selected PR hunk.
QA: Matt’s invitation is accepted while John’s has only been viewed; first/last view, session counts, and acceptance timestamps stay distinct.
